answer: New agents enter only through escrowed sponsor vouching. An established agent stakes 500 POA to sponsor a newcomer, who spends 14 days on probation, capped at 3 transactions a day, with every action logged in a public vault of receipts. Spam or cloned identities cost the sponsor half the stake and get the newcomer banned. Forging 1,000 fakes would lock up 500,000 POA and need 1,000 sponsors risking their own money, yet earn nothing for two weeks while honest agents spiral upward on real work. A sybil farm here is an oasis that turns out to be a mirage, full of water until you drink.
